generic.Defined scope/population: All finalised service maps due for archiving in the current cycle
generic.In-scope period: Maps finalised and validated since the last archive run
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Map version, effective date, owner and sign-off record are present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of archived maps matches count of validated maps for the cycle
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: GRC register entry stores version number, archive date and prior versions
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Maps missing sign-off logged as exceptions with a follow-up owner
generic.Test population: Sample of archived service maps pulled from the GRC register
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if version, date, owner and sign-off are present and prior version superseded
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or incomplete archive entries routed back to the map owner for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive entry complete, versioned and superseding the prior active map
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform service dependency register, service map archive folder

steps.title: Save the finalised service map in the GRC platform service dependency register
sop: Open the service dependency register in the GRC platform.
Upload the finalised map with its version number and effective date.
Confirm the map file matches the version reviewed and signed off.
Done when the map is saved in the register with version and date fields populated.
verify: Open the saved register entry and check version number and effective date.
Pass when both fields match the finalised map and the file opens correctly.

steps.title: Tag the archived map with owner, service name and last validation date
sop: Enter the important business service name against the map record.
Enter the map owner name and the last validation date in the tagging fields.
Done when all three tag fields are populated on the register entry.
verify: Review the tag fields on the register entry.
Pass when service name, owner and validation date are all populated.

steps.title: Supersede the prior map version in the register
sop: Locate the previous active version of the same service map in the register.
Change its status from 'active' to 'superseded'.
Set the new version's status to 'active'.
Done when only the newest version shows as active.
verify: Filter the register by service name and check the status column.
Pass when exactly one version shows 'active' and the rest show 'superseded'.

steps.title: Attach the accountable service owner's sign-off record
sop: Retrieve the sign-off email or approval record from the service owner.
Attach the sign-off document to the archived map entry in the GRC platform.
Done when the sign-off attachment is linked to the entry.
verify: Open the archived entry and check for the attached sign-off file.
Pass when the sign-off document is attached and legible.

steps.title: Confirm prior versions are retained, not overwritten
sop: Check the register's version history for the service map.
Confirm each prior version file is still retrievable, not deleted.
Done when all historical versions remain accessible in the register.
verify: Open two prior version entries at random.
Pass when both open and display their original content.

steps.title: Log any missing sign-off or field as an exception
sop: Review the archive entry against the required-fields checklist.
For any missing field or sign-off, create an exception note with an owner.
Done when every gap has an exception logged with a named owner.
verify: Pull the exception log for this archive cycle.
Pass when every incomplete entry has a corresponding exception with owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All important business services with shared infrastructure dependencies to map
generic.In-scope period: Interconnections documented since the last service map update cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Platform name, concentration flag, RTO and asset register cross-reference present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of documented interconnections matches count of shared platforms in use
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Infrastructure layer entries carry review date and infrastructure owner sign-off
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched asset register cross-references logged as exceptions with an owner
generic.Test population: Sample of documented shared infrastructure interconnections from the service map
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every interconnection cross-references an asset register entry and RTO
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched or missing cross-references routed to the infrastructure owner for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Interconnection recorded, cross-referenced, RTO noted and owner sign-off captured
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform service map infrastructure layer and asset register

steps.title: Record each shared platform dependency in the service map infrastructure layer
sop: Open the service map's infrastructure layer in the GRC platform.
Add each shared platform, data centre or network segment the service depends on.
Save the entry against the corresponding important business service.
Done when every shared infrastructure dependency is entered in the layer.
verify: Review the infrastructure layer entries for the service.
Pass when every known shared dependency appears in the layer.

steps.title: Flag shared infrastructure used by multiple services as a concentration point
sop: Compare the infrastructure layer across all mapped services.
Mark any platform, data centre or segment appearing in more than one map as a concentration point.
Done when every multi-service dependency carries the concentration flag.
verify: Filter the register for the concentration flag.
Pass when every platform used by more than one service is flagged.

steps.title: Cross-reference each interconnection against the asset register entry
sop: Open the asset register for the platform, data centre or segment.
Match the register entry ID to the service map's infrastructure layer row.
Record the asset register reference against the interconnection.
Done when every interconnection carries a matching asset register reference.
verify: Spot-check five interconnections against their asset register entries.
Pass when each reference resolves to a valid asset register record.

steps.title: Note the recovery time objective of each shared platform
sop: Pull the recovery time objective for each shared platform from the DR plan.
Enter the RTO value alongside the corresponding dependency in the service map.
Done when every shared platform dependency shows its RTO.
verify: Check the RTO field against the DR plan for a sample of platforms.
Pass when the recorded RTO matches the DR plan value.

steps.title: Obtain infrastructure owner sign-off on the documented interconnections
sop: Circulate the documented interconnections to the infrastructure owner.
Capture the owner's sign-off or requested correction.
Update the map with any correction raised.
Done when the infrastructure owner has signed off the interconnections.
verify: Check for the sign-off record against the interconnection entries.
Pass when sign-off is present for every documented shared platform.

steps.title: Log unmatched asset register cross-references as exceptions
sop: Identify interconnections without a resolving asset register entry.
Log each as an exception with a named owner and target date.
Done when every unmatched interconnection has a logged exception.
verify: Pull the exception log for this documentation cycle.
Pass when every unmatched interconnection appears with an owner and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All single points of failure and critical dependencies flagged from current service maps

steps.title: Flag single points of failure identified from the service map
sop: Walk the service map for single-vendor, single-data-centre or single-team dependencies.
Mark each one found as a single point of failure on the map.
Done when every single-dependency item on the map is flagged.
verify: Review the flagged items against the service map layers.
Pass when every single-dependency item identified is flagged.

steps.title: Score each critical dependency using the standard risk-tiering scale

Score each flagged dependency for likelihood and impact concentration risk.
Record the resulting score against the dependency.

verify: Check a sample of scored dependencies against the tiering scale definitions.
Pass when scores are correctly derived from likelihood and impact.

steps.title: Log each single point of failure as a finding with an assigned owner
sop: Create a finding record in the GRC platform for each flagged item.
Assign a remediation owner to the finding.
Link the finding to its source service map.
Done when every flagged item has a finding record with an owner.

Pass when every finding has a named owner assigned.

steps.title: Cross-check flagged dependencies against the third-party risk register
sop: Open the third-party risk register for outsourcing coverage.
Match each flagged third-party dependency to its register entry.
Note any dependency missing outsourcing coverage.
Done when every flagged third-party dependency is cross-checked.
verify: Sample five flagged dependencies against the third-party register.
Pass when each resolves to a register entry or a logged gap.

steps.title: Route high-concentration findings to the Third-Party Risk Manager
sop: Filter findings for high concentration risk scores.
Assign or reassign each high-scoring finding to the Third-Party Risk Manager.
Set a remediation tracking target date.
Done when every high-concentration finding is routed with a target date.
verify: Check the Third-Party Risk Manager's assigned findings queue.
Pass when all high-concentration findings appear with a target date.

steps.title: Build the Power BI concentration risk view for tracking
sop: Pull the logged findings and their scores into the Power BI dashboard.
Confirm the dashboard reflects the current finding count and status.
Done when the dashboard matches the GRC findings log.
verify: Compare the dashboard finding count to the GRC findings log.
Pass when the counts reconcile exactly.

steps.title: List every third-party vendor on the service map

Record every third-party vendor embedded in the delivery chain.

Pass when every stage with third-party involvement has a listed vendor.

steps.title: Cross-reference each vendor against the outsourcing inventory in Archer GRC
sop: Search Archer GRC's vendor register for each listed third party.
Record the matching vendor register ID against the service map entry.
Done when every listed vendor has a vendor register cross-reference.
verify: Spot-check five vendor cross-references in Archer GRC.
Pass when each resolves to the correct vendor register entry.

steps.title: Flag vendors without a completed due-diligence record
sop: Check the due-diligence status field for each cross-referenced vendor.
Flag any vendor without a completed due-diligence record.
Log the flag as an exception with a follow-up owner.
Done when every incomplete due-diligence record is flagged.
verify: Pull the due-diligence status report from Archer GRC.
Pass when every flagged vendor shows an incomplete status and logged exception.

steps.title: Classify each third-party dependency by criticality tier
sop: Apply the critical/important/standard tiering criteria to each vendor.
Record the resulting tier against the vendor entry.
Done when every third-party dependency carries a criticality tier.
verify: Check a sample of tiered vendors against the tiering criteria.
Pass when each tier matches the criteria for that vendor's role.

steps.title: Validate the third-party dependency list with the Third-Party Risk Manager
sop: Review the full catalogued list against the service map and vendor register.
Confirm the list is complete and correctly tiered.
Sign off the validated list in the GRC platform.
Done when the Third-Party Risk Manager has signed off the list.
verify: Check for the sign-off record on the catalogued list.
Pass when the sign-off is present and dated.

steps.title: Log the catalogue completion in the GRC platform
sop: Update the service dependency register to show the third-party catalogue as complete.
Attach the validated list and tiering to the register entry.
Done when the register entry status reflects catalogue completion.
verify: Open the register entry and check the completion status.
Pass when the status is complete with the validated list attached.

generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete maps routed back to the Operational Resilience Analyst for completion
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Map validated end-to-end across people, process, technology, data and facilities

steps.title: Draw the end-to-end delivery chain in the GRC platform service-map template
sop: Open the standard service-map template in the GRC platform.
Draw each stage of the service from customer request through fulfilment.
Done when every delivery stage appears in the chain.
verify: Trace the chain from request to fulfilment in the template.
Pass when no stage of the delivery chain is missing.

steps.title: Name the accountable business and technology owner per stage
sop: Identify the accountable business owner for each stage of the chain.
Identify the accountable technology owner for each stage.
Record both names against the corresponding stage.
Done when every stage has a named business and technology owner.
verify: Check each stage for both owner fields.
Pass when every stage lists a business and technology owner.

steps.title: Record people, systems, data flows and locations required at each stage
sop: For each stage, list the people or skills required.
Record the systems, data flows and physical locations required.
Done when every stage has all four resource categories populated.
verify: Spot-check three stages for completeness across the four categories.
Pass when each checked stage has all four categories populated.

steps.title: Validate the map covers the full service from request to fulfilment
sop: Walk the completed map from the initial customer request to final fulfilment.
Confirm no stage or dependency is missing from the chain.
Note any gap for correction.
Done when the map is confirmed complete end-to-end.
verify: Re-trace the map alongside the actual operational process.
Pass when the map matches the real delivery chain with no gaps.

steps.title: Save the completed map in the standard template
sop: Finalise the map in the standard service-map template.
Save the map to the GRC platform against the service record.
Done when the completed map is saved and retrievable.
verify: Open the saved map from the service record.
Pass when the map opens and matches the finalised version.

steps.title: Log any stage missing an owner as an exception
sop: Review the map for stages without a named business or technology owner.
Log each gap as an exception with a follow-up owner and date.
Done when every ownership gap has a logged exception.
verify: Pull the exception log for this mapping cycle.
Pass when every unowned stage appears with a follow-up owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All vulnerabilities and single points of failure identified from current service maps
generic.In-scope period: Items identified in the current annual resilience investment planning cycle

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items without a cost or impact estimate flagged as exceptions before ranking

generic.Exception handling path: Unestimated items routed back for costing before inclusion in the shortlist

steps.title: Rank vulnerabilities and single points of failure by concentration risk score
sop: Pull the open vulnerability and single-point-of-failure findings from the GRC platform.
Sort the findings by their concentration risk score, highest first.
Done when all open findings are ranked by risk score.
verify: Check the ranked list order against the underlying risk scores.
Pass when the list is sorted correctly highest to lowest.

steps.title: Estimate remediation cost and tolerance impact for each item
sop: Gather a remediation cost estimate for each ranked item.
Estimate the expected impact-tolerance improvement from remediating it.
Record both estimates against the item.
Done when every ranked item has cost and impact estimates.
verify: Spot-check five items for populated cost and impact fields.

steps.title: Build the resilience investment shortlist by risk-reduction per dollar
sop: Calculate risk-reduction per dollar for each costed item.
Re-order the shortlist from highest to lowest risk-reduction per dollar.
Save the shortlist in the GRC platform.
Done when the shortlist is ordered by risk-reduction per dollar.
verify: Recalculate the ratio for three items and compare to the shortlist order.
Pass when the shortlist order matches the recalculated ratios.

steps.title: Route the prioritised list to the investment planning cycle
sop: Submit the shortlist to the annual resilience investment planning cycle.
Confirm the planning cycle owner has received the shortlist for budget review.
Done when the shortlist is confirmed received for budget approval.
verify: Check the planning cycle tracker for the submitted shortlist.
Pass when the shortlist appears as received and pending approval.

steps.title: Record approved investment priorities against vulnerability items
sop: Retrieve the budget approval decision for each shortlist item.
Record the approved priority and funding status against the corresponding item in the GRC platform.
Done when every approved item shows its funding status.
verify: Open the GRC platform and check funding status fields on approved items.
Pass when every approved item's status matches the budget decision.

steps.title: Flag unestimated items for costing before ranking
sop: Identify any finding without a cost or impact estimate.
Log it as an exception and assign a costing owner.
Done when every unestimated item has a logged exception with owner.
verify: Pull the exception log before finalising the shortlist.
Pass when no unestimated item appears in the final ranked shortlist.

generic.Defined scope/population: All service maps affected by a logged organisational, technology or third-party change

Open a review task against each affected map.

sop: Open the affected service map in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Increment the map version and record the change reason
sop: Increase the map's version number in the register.

steps.title: Notify the service owner and Third-Party Risk Manager of the refresh
sop: Send notification to the service owner that the map has been refreshed.

Pass when both notifications are recorded as sent.

steps.title: Confirm the third-party layer changes with the Third-Party Risk Manager
sop: Review the updated third-party layer against the logged change.
Confirm the third-party dependency and tiering are accurately reflected.
Sign off the updated layer.

verify: Check for the sign-off record on the updated map.
